verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents an API action to delete a job and all associated resources, and states it doesn't log customer data by default. Self-hosted deployment also gives customers infrastructure-level control over where data lives. Evidence of user-configurable retention policies is absent, so the retention half of the story is only implied by defaults and deployment choice. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or settings, a documented scope for what job deletion removes, account- or workspace-level data-deletion controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
